subject.title: Feature: CLI command to force re-import browser cookie

question: Should CodexBar support eager browser-cookie re-import from the CLI, and if so should it extend `cache clear` or introduce a separate `cookie refresh` command?
rationale: Current main solves cache invalidation but not eager credential replacement; VISION.md reserves new authentication and storage behavior for sign-off, and the command shape determines whether CodexBar gains a parallel authentication-orchestration surface.

options.title: Extend cache clear
options.body: Add a provider-scoped `--reimport` or `--refresh` option that reuses shared provider cookie-import strategy metadata and avoids a parallel command namespace.

options.title: Add cookie refresh
options.body: Create a dedicated command with explicit provider eligibility, browser-order, Keychain, and all-provider semantics.

options.title: Keep two-step workflow
options.body: Document cache clearing followed by a normal provider fetch as the supported account-switch recovery path and decline eager import.

recommendation.title: Extend cache clear
recommendation.body: Add a provider-scoped `--reimport` or `--refresh` option that reuses shared provider cookie-import strategy metadata and avoids a parallel command namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md makes this an explicit product and authentication-surface decision, and the repository owner is the clearest available decision owner.
